**Finding: COMPLIANT (meets preferred).** No redline proposed.

- **§ 24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor's consent (notice only).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and cannot go to a direct competitor.
- **§ 24.3** — Mutual, reasonableness-qualified consent for other assignments.
- **§ 24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration, or service-reduction right.
- **§ 13.3** — Customer-only licence transfer right aligned to permitted assignments.

Only note (not a deviation): the competitor bar in § 24.2 is consent-gated rather than absolute, which remains within our control.
